description: Windows launcher for organizing and opening application shortcuts.
pre_install: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir '$PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Orbit application payload archive was not found in the NSIS package.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'Orbit.exe') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Orbit.exe was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dir 'resources\app.asar') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'resources\app.asar was not extracted into the Scoop version directory.' }
